final: WITH g AS (SELECT transref AS tid, AVG(anlycount) AS gavg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), o AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS oavg FROM g WHERE gavg IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT g.tid AS tid, g.gavg AS gavg, g.gavg - o.oavg AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oavg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.gavg IS NOT NULL AND g.gavg > o.oavg), f AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS favg FROM p WHERE gavg IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.tid, p.gavg, p.diff, p.gavg - f.favg AS final_diff FROM p JOIN f ON f.favg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY final_diff IS NULL, final_diff DESC LIMIT 10
